notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
rsync over port 873 (unauthenticated by default) allows direct file download from exposed shares. rsync -av rsync://target/share pulls all files in the share. Commonly exposes .ssh directories, secrets.yaml, configuration files.

=== CHAINING ===
nc probe reveals share names → rsync -av --list-only (enumerate without downloading) → rsync -av to download → grep for credentials, SSH keys, configs.

=== CRITICAL FINDINGS ===
.ssh/id_rsa or id_rsa.pub in rsync shares: immediate critical finding. SSH keys pulled from rsync → direct SSH access with no further exploitation needed.
